response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial domain exposure (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS) and some high-throughput, low-latency backend work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby. However, the core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) systems development — is only weakly evidenced by a ~7-month C/C++ role at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a student project; recent years are dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and D. There is no experience with routing/navigation data pipelines, tiling, or map data processing, and distributed-systems depth is implied rather than demonstrated. Worth a screening call given the strong learning orientation and GIS background, but the language and domain gap is significant for a mid-senior IC expected to own critical pipeline components.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial/GIS platform experience (GISCollective, Green Map)
Low-latency, high-volume microservices work with async I/O and caching
Broad polyglot systems background with strong testing/CI/TDD discipline
concerns: Minimal and dated C++ experience; no Rust; no modern C++ signals
No navigation, routing, or map-tiling pipeline experience
Recent roles are web/full-stack TypeScript, not systems-level engineering
